CHALLENGE class EventBus { #listeners = new Map(); on(event, fn) { if (!this.#listeners.has(event)) this.#listeners.set(event, new Set()); this.#listeners.get(event).add(fn); return () => this.#listeners.get(event).delete(fn); } emit(event, payload) { this.#listeners.get(event)?.forEach(fn => fn(payload)); } } const bus = new EventBus(); const log = []; const unsub = bus.on('data', v => log.push(`A:${v}`)); bus.on('data', v => log.push(`B:${v}`)); bus.emit('data', 1); unsub(); bus.on('data', v => log.push(`C:${v}`)); bus.emit('data', 2); console.log(log.join(','));

❓ TermDOM: Build Terminal UIs with HTML, CSS and the DOM Like the look of Ink but don't like React?
